player_prompt.intro:
Yu em Player {player_id}. Yu em pilai 15-Puzzle gem.
Objektiv bilong gem em arangeim numbared tiles i go insait long orda apinun, from 1 go long 15, wantaim spes emti i stap long korner btm-rait.
Long mekim muv, yu ken slidim tile i go long spes emti (i reprisentim olsem double underscore, e.g. __) by usim wanpela bilong dispela komanda:
- 'ap': Muvim tile i stap aninita long spes emti i go ap.
- 'daun': Muvim tile i stap antap long spes emti i go daun.
- 'lef': Muvim tile i stap rait long spes emti i go lef.
- 'rait': Muvim tile i stap lef long spes emti i go rait.
Long submitim yu muv, taipim direksan (e.g., 'ap', 'daun', 'lef', o 'rait') insait long skwea brakets, e.g. [up].
Boriti karekt layout i stap aninita. Usim infomesin i go solvum puzzle.

invalid_move.wrong_format: I no orait long dispela pasin. Man i pilai {player_id} em i no bekim stret na makim rot bilong en insait long brackets.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Invalid move. The tile cannot be moved in the specified direction.

outcome.win: Congratulations! Player {player_id} have successfully solved the 15-Puzzle.
outcome.turn_limit: Ol i pinisim pinis {percent} pesen bilong dispela tok piksa.
